companyDescription: Cardiorenal · lorundrostat, a highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor for uncontrolled/resistant hypertension — PDUFA Dec 22, 2026; second-to-market behind AstraZeneca baxdrostat
priceNote: Live $15.52 (-2.9%) on Nov 11, 2026, near the bottom of its $14.91–$47.65 52-week range. Market cap is ~$1.45B (~94M shares) against $625M cash, so EV is ~$0.8B. The stock is down ~67% from its high since AstraZeneca's baxdrostat reached market first.
summary: This is a re-rating moonshot built on a dated, approval-likely PDUFA: lorundrostat for hypertension on Dec 22, 2026. The stock has fallen from $47.65 to $15.52 (-67%) as AstraZeneca's baxdrostat launched first. With EV ~$0.8B for a drug addressing a mass-market hypertension population (and 48-week OLE data showing -17.8 mmHg at AHA 2026), approval plus a clean label is a "disbelief" re-rating setup. The stale consensus mean is ~$48.50 (BofA $49). Cash of $625M funds the launch into 2028, so there is no survival flag. fda_decision is the strongest Tier-2 leader (+9.3pp vs +2.0, n=10). It was a near-miss on Nov 4 (Base ~+40%), and it ranks #5 here on the same Base. The Moon (+212%) is a return to the 52-week high and needs a label that competes head-to-head plus launch traction. แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า CRL ลงได้ 40–50%.

catalysts.name: Lorundrostat PDUFA — hypertension
catalysts.description: The NDA for lorundrostat as add-on therapy in uncontrolled/resistant hypertension has a PDUFA target action date of Dec 22, 2026. Review is underway per the Nov 8 update, and the commercial organization is being built ahead of the date.

risks: Second to market: AstraZeneca's baxdrostat is already launched. Even with approval, the commercial ceiling is contested, which is why Base is only ~+40%.
Label risk: hyperkalemia monitoring language or a narrow population would cap the re-rating even on approval.
A CRL would be a ~40–50% hit for a single-asset company even with $625M cash.
The consensus target (~$48.50) is stale (pre-baxdrostat launch), so treat the analyst upside as overstated.
R/R ~4:1 is below the 5:1 turbo target.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE was 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE on Nov 25 is the next print, then Nov CPI on Dec 10, the day after FOMC.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Single-asset cardiorenal biotech moving into launch. Funded into 2028. Rates matter through the biotech multiple only.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the PDUFA (Dec 22) lands after the Dec 9 FOMC and Dec 10 CPI, so macro volatility arrives first and may offer a better entry.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · ค่าขนม 2% max — the best-measured catalyst type (fda_decision +9.3pp) on an approval-likely PDUFA, at an EV of ~$0.8B. Upside is capped by being second to market, so R/R is ~4:1. Measured turbo at-catalyst median is -13.7% (n=19), so Entry 2 is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: There is no run-up: MLYS is grinding along its 52-week low into the PDUFA (-2.9% today). One calendar shows a ~-25% move into the date, so this is a disbelief setup, not a crowded one.

postWin.note: AXSM rose ~40% on an approval the market had doubted (Auvelity, Aug 2022). SRPT closed +74% on a contested approval (Sep 2016). MLYS is approval-likely, so expect the low end unless the label surprises.

postLose.note: CAPR opened -38.6% on a CRL (Jul 2025), the template for a PDUFA rejection in a single-asset company.

spotSizing.reason: 2%. fda_decision is the strongest Tier-2 leader (+9.3pp vs +2.0, n=10, 0/10 windows with SPY down >2%). R/R ~4:1 and second-to-market economics keep it at the turbo floor.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the turbo medianMAE (-24.1%). A close below ~$11.60 means the market is pricing a CRL or label problem.

stopPostCatalyst.note: On a CRL, exit day 1. On a narrow or heavily monitored label, cut to half.

comparableCases.event: FDA approves Auvelity after an extended review
comparableCases.note: An approval the market doubted, taking the stock from depressed to re-rated. That is the MLYS setup if the label is clean.
Single-asset CRL template, and the downside if the FDA balks at lorundrostat's label or safety.

th.summary: Moonshot แบบ re-rate จาก PDUFA ที่มีวันแน่นอนและมีแนวโน้มอนุมัติ: lorundrostat รักษาความดันโลหิตสูง วันที่ 22 ธ.ค. 2026 หุ้นร่วงจาก $47.65 เหลือ $15.52 (-67%) หลัง baxdrostat ของ AstraZeneca เปิดตลาดก่อน EV ~$0.8B สำหรับยาที่มีตลาดความดันสูงขนาดใหญ่ (และข้อมูล OLE 48 สัปดาห์ที่ AHA 2026 ลดความดันได้ -17.8 mmHg) การอนุมัติพร้อม label ที่ดีจึงเป็นจังหวะ re-rate จาก "ความไม่เชื่อ" consensus เฉลี่ย (เก่า) ~$48.50 (BofA $49) เงินสด $625M รองรับการเปิดตลาดถึงปี 2028 จึงไม่ติด survival flag fda_decision เป็น leader ที่แรงที่สุดใน Tier-2 (+9.3pp เทียบ +2.0, n=10) เคยเป็น near-miss เมื่อ 4 พ.ย. (Base ~+40%) และติดอันดับ 5 รอบนี้ด้วย Base เดิม Moon (+212%) คือกลับไป 52-week high ต้องได้ label ที่แข่งได้ตรงๆ และยอดเปิดตลาดดี แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้าโดน CRL ลงได้ 40–50%
